title: CPI for all items increases 0.6% in September; gasoline rises
author: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
summary: In September, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.6 percent, seasonally adjusted (SA), and rose 3.7 percent over the year, not seasonally adjusted (NSA). The index for all items less food and…
bodyHtml: In September, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.6 percent, seasonally adjusted (SA), and rose 3.7 percent over the year, not seasonally adjusted (NSA). The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in September (SA), up 2.6 percent over the year (NSA).
